summary: Benchmarks opened modestly higher on firm global cues but quickly settled into a narrow range, with gains concentrated in a handful of heavyweights on expiry day.

detail.leaders: Trent, Kotak Bank, Axis Bank, Reliance, HCLTech, IndiGo
detail.laggards: HDFC Bank, Bharti Airtel, M&M, SBI
detail.tone: Slightly softer than the pre-open signal: the Nifty briefly went above 22,600 before settling just above 22,550, with the Sensex up about 100 points.
